# Bereket Kinfe — Software Engineer

> Software engineer building thoughtful web, mobile, and AI-powered systems from Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.

## About

I'm a software engineer who likes working across the whole product — from interfaces and frontend architecture to APIs, data, and the messy problems underneath them. Over the last ~4 years I've worked on everything from multi-tenant marketplaces and large ERP systems to AI-powered voice applications and mobile products.

## Primary Stack

- TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js
- React Native (Mobile)
- Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- PostgreSQL, MySQL, Prisma, Redis
- WebSockets, REST APIs, GraphQL
- AWS, Vercel, Docker

## Featured Projects

- [Afrilearn Platform](https://afrilearn.net): Rebuilt frontend for the AI-powered education platform. Achieved 100/100 Google Lighthouse across all categories. Reduced LCP from 3.8s to 0.7s. Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- [AI Visa Interview Simulator](https://github.com/Bekione): Real-time voice AI mock visa interview simulator with sub-second latency. Full-duplex WebSocket audio streaming with ONNX-powered BERT-based Voice Activity Detection.
- [ISP Multi-Tenant Marketplace](https://github.com/Bekione): Multi-tenant ISP marketplace with customer, ISP admin, and platform admin tiers. Built with React, React Native, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Nest.js, and PostgreSQL.
- [Spare-Parts Enterprise ERP](https://github.com/Bekione): High-performance inventory management system handling 10M+ records with windowed virtualization and sub-100ms response times. Built with React, Laravel, MySQL, Redis.

## Open Source & Developer Tools

- [Commit-Tastic](https://github.com/Bekione/commit-tastic): VS Code extension for automated, context-aware Git commit messages powered by local LLMs.
- [ThreadMind](https://github.com/Bekione/threadmind): AI Telegram bot that summarizes unread group chat threads into concise briefing notes.
- [FreelanceHub](https://github.com/Bekione/FreelanceHub): Open-source freelance client and project management suite with automated Stripe invoicing.
